youtube_title: Virtus vs Slavia: which is cheaper to own over 5 years?
caption:
Virtus or Slavia: which one really costs less over 5 years? 🚗

Same 1.0 TSI engine, same mileage, same service cost. The only real difference is the price you pay on day one.

Base Virtus (Comfortline 1.0 TSI MT): about Rs 13.2 lakh on-road, Rs 17.4 lakh over 5 years.
Base Slavia (Classic 1.0 TSI MT): about Rs 11.9 lakh on-road, Rs 16.1 lakh over 5 years.

That's about Rs 2,200 a month less for the Slavia.

Estimate for Hyderabad: 30 km a day, 20% down payment, 5-year loan at 9%, after resale value. Your city and variant will change the numbers.

Which one would you pick? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇

voice_lines: Both have the same one litre TSI engine, so fuel and service cost the same. About eighty four thousand rupees of petrol a year, at thirty kilometres a day.
The difference is the price. A base Virtus is about thirteen point two lakh on-road in Hyderabad. A base Slavia, about eleven point nine lakh.
Add loan interest, insurance, fuel, service and tyres, then take away the resale value. Over five years, the Virtus costs about seventeen point four lakh. The Slavia, about sixteen point one lakh.
So the Slavia costs about two thousand two hundred rupees a month less. These are estimates for base manual variants. Which one would you pick? Comment below.
